content:
Created `CHANGELOG.md` with a standard [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.1.0/) skeleton. It includes:

- Project title and description of the format standard
- An **Unreleased** section ready to capture upcoming changes
- All six standard subsections under Unreleased: **Added**, **Changed**, **Deprecated**, **Removed**, **Fixed**, **Security**

As work progresses on this repository, you can move entries under the appropriate subsections, and when cutting a release, rename `[Unreleased]` to a version tag like `[1.0.0] - 2026-08-29` and start a fresh `[Unreleased]` section above it.
